subcommands.description: Create a cloud service (extended support). Please note some properties can be set only during cloud service creation
subcommands.name: create

options.description: Name of the cloud service
name: --cloud-service-name
--name
-n

options.description: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using az configure --defaults group=<name>
name: --resource-group
-g

options.description: Specify the XML service configuration (.cscfg) for the cloud service. Expected value: xml-string/@xml-file
options.name: --configuration

options.description: Specify a URL that refers to the location of the service configuration in the Blob service. The service package URL can be Shared Access Signature (SAS) URI from any storage account. This is a write-only property and is not returned in GET calls
options.name: --configuration-url

options.description: List of extensions for the cloud service. Expected value: json-string/@json-file. Example: [{"properties": {"type": "RDP", "autoUpgradeMinorVersion": false, "protectedSettings": "settings","publisher": "Microsoft.Windows.Azure.Extensions", "settings": "settings", "typeHandlerVersion": "1.2.1"}, "name": "RDPExtension"}]
options.name: --extensions

options.description: Resource Id
options.name: --id

options.description: The list of load balancer configurations separated by space for the cloud service. The public IP is a mandatory field. Format: LBName:FrontendIPConfiguration:PublicIPAddress:Subnet:PrivateIP
name: --load-balancer-configurations
--lb

options.description: Location. Values from: az account list-locations. You can configure the default location using az configure --defaults location=<location>
name: --location
-l

options.description: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish
options.name: --no-wait

options.description: Specify a URL that refers to the location of the service package in the Blob service. The service package URL can be Shared Access Signature (SAS) URI from any storage account. This is a write-only property and is not returned in GET calls
options.name: --package-url

options.description: List of roles separated by space for the cloud service. Format: RoleName:SkuName:SkuCapacity:SkuTier
options.name: --roles

options.description: Specify certificates separated by space that should be installed onto the role instances. Format: KeyVaultName:CertificateUrl:CertificateUrl2:...:CertificateUrlN
options.name: --secrets

options.description: Indicate whether to start the cloud service immediately after it is created. The default value is true. If false, the service model is still deployed, but the code is not run immediately. Instead, the service is PoweredOff until you call Start, at which time the service will be started. A deployed service still incurs charges, even if it is poweredoff
options.name: --start-cloud-service

options.description: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value] ...]. Use "" to clear existing tags
options.name: --tags

options.description: Update mode for the cloud service. Role instances are allocated to update domains when the service is deployed. Updates can be initiated manually in each update domain or initiated automatically in all update domains. Possible Values are Auto, Manual, Simultaneous. If not specified, the default value is Auto. If set to Manual, PUT UpdateDomain must be called to apply the update. If set to Auto, the update is automatically applied to each update domain in sequence
options.name: --upgrade-mode
